interpretation_limits: Pacer feedback in each row is from previous_step; current measured layer and palm angles are post-action.
Mapped median layer twist is an approximation when selected cubelets have off-axis motion or dispersion.
Raw velocity gate uses world omega_cubelet minus world omega_Core; absolute raw speeds are shown separately.
Contact counts in ready/approach phases are descriptive, not contact-retention failures.
No learned-policy success or unobserved closed-loop outcome is inferred.
All three turn phases occur after recorded generic pickup terminal; they are physical continuation diagnostics, not valid original-episode turn acceptance evidence.
